_: Editorial for homepage sections that are driven by the catalogue. Only the club finder so far — the rest of page-home.html is still prose in markup.
_why: The finder used to hard-code a name, a price and an image per card. The prices had drifted: both LGW02s said $119 when the store charges $109. Nothing on this site should retype a price that products.json already holds.

cards.ln: One wedge, six lofts and two sole grinds. The one that makes you stop blaming the swing.
The same shape, blacked out. Gold on the clover and nothing else.
Short ones start to feel like a formality. Quiet off the face.
More head behind the ball, so the ones you catch thin still finish close.
The one you reach for when the long shot has to find the green.
